description: This file provides low-level system call functionalities for gRPC on Linux, including CPU time measurement, resource usage retrieval, and TCP socket options management.

methods.name: GetCPUTime
methods.description: Returns the CPU time used by the process since start, in nanoseconds.

methods.name: GetRusage
methods.description: Retrieves resource usage statistics for the current process.

methods.name: CPUTimeDiff
methods.description: Calculates the difference in user and system CPU time between two resource usage snapshots.

methods.name: SetTCPUserTimeout
methods.description: Sets the TCP user timeout option on a network connection.

methods.name: GetTCPUserTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the TCP user timeout setting from a network connection.
